reddit.detail: RETIRED 2026-07-20. Reddit blocks unauthenticated JSON: old.reddit.com 403 and www.reddit.com 403, tested live with a browser User-Agent. No REDDIT_CLIENT_ID exists anywhere in the repo, so no request this system can make will succeed. The endpoint fix in 9bc2849 (old.reddit + raw_json=1) was correct code against a door that is shut. Reviving this source requires a registered OAuth app and oauth.reddit.com — not a code change here.

value.regime_read: ES & NQ moving together — broad agreement, more DURABLE directional signal. Trust the direction more.
value.narrative:
Macro backdrop —
[2026-08-12] US economic state (FRED):
  Growth: real GDP 1.5% (q/q ann)
  Inflation: CPI 2.87% YoY | core CPI 1.93% | core PCE 2.8% (Fed target 2%)
  Labor: unemployment 4.1%
  Rates: fed funds 3.63% | 10Y 4.72% | 10Y-2Y 0.48% (NORMAL)
  Consumer: UMich sentiment 49.5 | VIX 15.46

---
Recent market action shows a strong move higher in both ES and NQ, with the S&P 500 futures (ES) up by 0.2% and Nasdaq-100 futures (NQ) up by 0.58%. The lead-lag analysis indicates that ES and NQ are moving together, suggesting a broad agreement in market sentiment. This regime of 'BREADTH' implies a more durable directional signal, which we should trust more for our trading decisions. However, the mixed signals from the recent news items, particularly the geopolitical tensions between US and Iran, introduce some uncertainty. The FOMC inflation print is due today at 8:30 ET, which could impact market sentiment. Given the current regime and the lack of strong divergence or lead-lag signals, we maintain a long bias with a probability of ~75%. This bias can be invalidated if either ES falls below 7740 or NQ drops below 29600.
